review_method: Read the complete answer text in both completed run JSONs manually.
mechanism_evidence: Run 1 explicitly uses the colored ray alignment to select B, with arithmetic and area errors. Run 2 correctly rejects B for lacking a white quarter circle and selects E; its description of C angle is inaccurate. Only the explicit final choices B/E determine the miss.
limitations: Two observations, no original controls, and no statistical or causal claim.
